title: Beyond Closed-Pool Video Retrieval: A Benchmark and Agent Framework for Real-World Video Search and Moment Localization
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark for evaluating video retrieval and localization capabilities in multimodal Large Language Models. While one of the sample data points used for testing describes a scene in a church with 'indescribable sacredness,' the research itself does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
